lines.zh: 八条腕一起推水，速度不慢。
lines.en: All eight arms push the water; I am not slow.

lines.zh: 我用腕尖探路，礁石太糙。
lines.en: I feel the way with arm tips; the reef is rough.

lines.zh: 贴着沙底滑，影子会淡掉。
lines.en: Skimming the sand, my shadow fades away.

lines.zh: 挤过这条石缝，骨头都省了。
lines.en: I squeeze through this crack; no bones to stop me.
My arms take turns gripping, as if climbing.

lines.zh: 海水在推，我顺着走就是。
lines.en: The sea pushes; I simply go with it.

lines.zh: 从珊瑚背后绕，别被看见。
lines.en: I circle behind the coral, staying unseen.

lines.zh: 我的颜色跟着海底变了。
lines.en: My color shifts to match the seafloor.
I drift sideways so the crabs stay calm.
Arms tucked in, I slip through faster.

lines.zh: 深水更安静，我往那边去。
lines.en: Deeper water is quieter; I head that way.
A trail of sucker marks is left in the sand.

lines.zh: 我先伸一条腕，试试深浅。
lines.en: I extend one arm first to test the depth.
I travel at night and hide through the day.

lines.zh: 我把一条腕伸进石缝，试了试。
lines.en: I slide one arm into the crevice and test it.

lines.zh: 我顺着礁石的斜坡往下滑。
lines.en: I slide down the slope of the reef.

lines.zh: 腕足缠住自己，算是休息。
lines.en: I curl my arms around myself to rest.

lines.zh: 皮肤一收一放，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My skin pulses slowly, like breathing.
I watch the crevice, waiting for a crab.

lines.zh: 吸盘贴着石头，一动不动。
lines.en: Suckers hold the rock; I do not move.
This lockbox is heavy; I drag it along.

lines.zh: 换个颜色，和海草一个调。
lines.en: A new color, matching the seagrass.

lines.zh: 我的喙藏在腕中间，很硬。
lines.en: My beak hides among the arms, hard as stone.

lines.zh: 水从鳃边过，凉得很舒服。
lines.en: Water flows past my gills, cool and soothing.
My eyes stay open while I doze.

lines.zh: 有人打开 Jade，看我的名字。
lines.en: Someone opens Jade to read my name.

lines.zh: 石头底下有只贝壳在动。
lines.en: Under the stone, a shell is moving.
I count my arms; still eight of them.

lines.zh: 这处礁洞正好够我转身。
lines.en: This reef hole is just wide enough to turn.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我留在阴影里。
lines.en: The tide pulls back; I stay in shadow.
You stand in the water, a new scent.

lines.zh: 你的影子压过来，我缩了缩。
lines.en: Your shadow falls; I shrink a little.

lines.zh: 我在看你的手，有没有网。
lines.en: I watch your hands for a net.

lines.zh: 你呼吸冒泡，我听得清楚。
lines.en: Your bubbles rise; I hear each one.

lines.zh: 别踩那块石头，我在下面。
lines.en: Do not step on that rock; I am beneath it.
Your armor is bright enough to sting my eyes.
You crouch down—are you trying to catch me?

lines.zh: 我抬起一条腕，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I lift one arm in greeting.
Your boots are sinking into the sand.

lines.zh: 我认得提网的人，你不像。
lines.en: I know net-carriers; you do not look like one.

lines.zh: 我的腕被划开了，缩回来。
lines.en: My arm is cut; I pull it back.
Soft flesh takes a hit and goes numb.
I release a cloud of ink and retreat.
Who dares strike inside my hole?

lines.zh: 吸盘掉了几只，长回来要久。
lines.en: I lost a few suckers; regrowth is slow.
The pain makes me cling to the rock.
Not the head; my beak is in there.
That blow nearly knocked my lockbox loose.
I curl into a ball, smaller now.
There is blood in the water; I must leave.

lines.zh: 网一撒下来，我就没处躲。
lines.en: Once the net drops, there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 你手里那只蟹，我闻到了。
lines.en: I smell the crab in your hand.
Raw cod will do; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 把桶放低些，我可以进去。
lines.en: Lower the bucket; I might climb in.

lines.zh: 你晃那个亮东西，我好奇。
lines.en: You wave that shiny thing; I am curious.

lines.zh: 锁箱的钥匙你带来了吗？
lines.en: Did you bring the lockbox key?
The food is by my arm; I hold back.
Stay still; I will come get it myself.

lines.zh: 这块贝壳肉，值一次冒险。
lines.en: That shell meat is worth one risk.

lines.zh: 你撒的饵散开了，真浪费。
lines.en: Your bait is drifting apart, such a waste.
Your leg brushed one of my arms.

lines.zh: 别挤，我八条腕也占地方。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; eight arms take space.
You stepped on my suckers.
You muddied the water; I cannot see.
I bump you, and it feels soft.
A bit left—there is rock that way.

lines.zh: 我的腕缠上你的靴子了。
lines.en: One arm has wrapped around your boot.
You swim too fast; the water is churning.
We collided and neither of us is hurt.
Move aside; I need that hole.
Eight arms intertwine; that counts as closeness.

lines.zh: 我把最亮的颜色给她看。
lines.en: I show her my brightest colors.

lines.zh: 这片礁够安静，可以留下卵。
lines.en: This reef is quiet enough to leave eggs.
She swims near; I change my patterns.
My arm gently touches hers.
The tide is right, and so is the hour.
We hide in the same crevice.

lines.zh: 她的颜色比我淡，很好看。
lines.en: Her colors are paler than mine, and lovely.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，这是我们的事。
lines.en: Do not come closer; this is between us.
The eggs will hang on the rock, tiny strands.
This coin? I tuck it in my lockbox.
A fallen crab shell; I will keep it.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西，我替你捡了。
lines.en: I picked up what you dropped.
This shard of pottery has a nice color.
I roll it in an arm so it is not lost.

lines.zh: 锁箱里还有地方，放得下。
lines.en: The lockbox has room; it fits.
The crabs will like this bone.
The sunken bait is mine now.
I pick it up, then put it back.

lines.zh: 会反光的小东西，我都想碰。
lines.en: Any little thing that glints, I want to touch.
That crab walks sideways, far too boldly.

lines.zh: 石缝里的小鱼，跑不掉了。
lines.en: The little fish in the crevice cannot escape.
I have my eye on that shell.
The bucket in your hand counts as a target.
It ducks into a hole; I follow.

lines.zh: 一只海胆太扎手，换一个。
lines.en: A sea urchin is too prickly; next one.
Movement on the left; I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我的腕已经伸出去一半。
lines.en: One arm is already halfway out.

lines.zh: 那只蟹举着钳子，不怕我。
lines.en: That crab raises its claws, unafraid.
I will take a small one first, steadier.
I circle behind and press with an arm.
It dodges left; I block beforehand.
I slow down and wait for it to emerge.

lines.zh: 吸盘贴上壳，就挣脱不了。
lines.en: Once suckers grip the shell, it cannot break free.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的钳，别被夹到。
lines.en: I watch its claws; I will not be pinched.

lines.zh: 它在沙里埋着，我看得出。
lines.en: It is buried in sand, but I can tell.

lines.zh: 三条腕封住退路，够用了。
lines.en: Three arms seal the retreat; that is enough.

lines.zh: 气泡挡住视线，我换个角度。
lines.en: Bubbles block my view; I shift angle.

lines.zh: 它快没力气了，再等一会。
lines.en: It is tiring; I wait a moment more.
No rush; the water works for me.
An arm whips out with a smack.

lines.zh: 我抽它一下，它翻了个身。
lines.en: One lash, and it flips over.
Suckers stick to it; it cannot shake loose.

lines.zh: 我用腕尖敲壳，试试硬度。
lines.en: I tap the shell with an arm tip, testing.
A burst of ink, and it goes blind.

lines.zh: 软的东西，打起来不费劲。
lines.en: Soft prey is easy to strike.
I wrap it and scrape it on the rock.
This blow is light, only a warning.
My arm coils twice and tightens.

lines.zh: 蟹钳夹空，我的腕已经收了。
lines.en: The claw snaps shut on nothing.
I slide out from a crack in the reef.
A new stretch of sea, with a different taste.
I settle onto the sand very lightly.
Which ocean is this? Let me look first.
Eight arms spread to check my surroundings.
I come from the deep, lockbox in tow.
The coral is alive; this is a good place.

lines.zh: 我换了个颜色，先藏起来。
lines.en: I change color and hide for now.
The tide carried me to this spot.
A rare place for a rare creature.

lines.zh: 出水太久，皮肤都在发烫。
lines.en: Out of water too long, my skin burns.

lines.zh: 摔在甲板上，八条腕都软了。
lines.en: Dropped on the deck, all eight arms go limp.

lines.zh: 我生在水里，居然也会呛。
lines.en: Born in water, and still I choke.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，墨都散了。
lines.en: The blast flips me; my ink scatters.
An arrow slips between my arms, too close.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我变了颜色。
lines.en: That magic forced my color to change.
Three days without crab; my arms feel weak.

lines.zh: 雷落进海里，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits the sea; I tingle all over.
Below there is no water and no floor.
